justificativa: The patch adds an after_update callback on both Student and Professor that, when `saved_change_to_name?` is true and a user is associated, writes the new name to `user.name` with `update_column`. This avoids recursion and User validations, which is what the issue asks for. It does not cover the extra case the official fix handles (a user_id change linking an existing user), but the issue does not request that.
